# Canwell House Brand Asset Manifest

All files generated by `brand/build_assets.py` from the master SVGs in `brand/src/`.
Do not edit files in `dist/` by hand; regenerate with `python3 brand/build_assets.py`.

## Favicon & Browser Icons

| File | Dimensions | Colour | Use |
|------|-----------|--------|-----|
| `favicon.svg` | vector | Full colour | Modern browsers, `<link rel="icon">` |
| `favicon.ico` | 16/32/48 packed | Full colour | Legacy browsers, `<link rel="shortcut icon">` |
| `favicon-16.png` | 16x16 | Full colour | Fallback favicon PNG |
| `favicon-32.png` | 32x32 | Full colour | Fallback favicon PNG |

## PWA & Touch Icons

| File | Dimensions | Colour | Use |
|------|-----------|--------|-----|
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180x180 | Mark on stone, 12% padding | iOS home screen, `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">` |
| `icon-192.png` | 192x192 | Mark on stone | PWA manifest `icon`, Android home screen |
| `icon-512.png` | 512x512 | Mark on stone | PWA manifest `icon`, splash screen source |
| `icon-512-maskable.png` | 512x512 | Mark in 60% safe zone, stone bleed | PWA manifest `icon` with `purpose: "maskable"` |

## Open Graph / Social Sharing

| File | Dimensions | Colour | Use |
|------|-----------|--------|-----|
| `og-canwellhouse-1200x630.webp` | 1200x630 | Stacked lockup on stone | General `og:image` meta tag |
| `og-canwellhouse-1200x630.jpg` | 1200x630 | Stacked lockup on stone | LinkedIn `og:image` (JPG required for reliable LinkedIn preview) |

The JPG is the reference image for LinkedIn sharing. The WebP is for general `og:image` use.
